From: Samir Rao <samir@openlib.org>
To: Camila Reyes <camila@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 13 Sep 2027 16:02:00 -0700
Subject: Demo request: GitHub integration for OpenLib

Hi Camila,

I signed up for Redwood a few days ago after seeing the GitHub integration mentioned in the docs. We’re an open-source data tooling org (OpenLib) and we’re evaluating vendor options to automate repo scanning and model inference workflows triggered from PRs. A couple of specific questions before a deeper eval:

- Does Redwood support GitHub App installation or do we need to use PATs?
- Can we route inference to our Dedicated capacity (we need predictable throughput for CI jobs)?
- Any notes on SSO / SCIM for orgs with SAML SSO?

Would love a quick demo (20-30min) next week to see the integration flow and ask some security questions. I’m in PDT (UTC-7). Available windows: Tue/Wed 9-11am or Thu 1-3pm.

Attaching a short security questionnaire and a link to the repo we care about.

Thanks,
Samir
Samir Rao
Platform Lead, OpenLib
samir@openlib.org

Attachment: security_questionnaire.pdf
Link: https://github.com/openlib/openlib-repo

Also, quick follow-ups so we can prep internally:

From: Camila Reyes <camila@redwood.ai>
To: Samir Rao <samir@openlib.org>
Cc: Priya Natarajan <priya@openlib.org>, Alex Martinez <alex@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 15 Sep 2027 10:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Demo request: GitHub integration for OpenLib

Perfect — we’ll do Wed 9/15 at 11:00am PDT. I’ve sent a calendar invite to both of you (see link below). If you need a different anchor time I can reschedule.

Quick answers ahead of the call so the security team can review:
- GitHub integration: we offer a GitHub App that can be scoped to specific repos/orgs. For CI/PR workflows we support both webhook triggers and a pull-based model for diffs. The runtime processes code diffs and metadata; by default we do not store source longer than the retention you configure and we support repo-level redaction and prefix-only caching.
- SSO/SCIM: Redwood supports SAML SSO with Okta and SCIM provisioning for user sync on Dedicated and Private deployments.
- Dedicated pinning: yes — you can pin repo-derived jobs to a Dedicated capacity pool via routing policies and repo annotations.

Alex will be on the call to cover the integration wiring and any technical follow-ups from Priya.

Invite / Meeting: https://calendly.com/redwood/demo-30?event=20270915-1100
Attachments: redwood-datasheet.pdf

1) Confirm attendee list for the demo (Samir, Priya, optional: two engineers).
2) Attach any additional security docs/questions to this thread so Alex can prep.

Thanks — talk soon.
